name: Zebras Unite
originator: Jennifer Brandel; Mara Zepeda; Astrid Scholz; Aniyia Williams
ethos: Founder-led, cooperatively owned movement for companies that are both profitable and improve society ('zebras'), offered as an ethical, inclusive alternative to unicorn/VC culture.
key_voices: Jennifer Brandel; Mara Zepeda; Astrid Scholz; Aniyia Williams
evidence_quote: A founder-led, cooperatively owned movement creating the culture, capital & community for the next economy
notes: Catalyzed by the March 2017 essay 'Zebras Fix What Unicorns Break'. Verified anchor (Ethan blueprint).

name: Indie Hackers
ethos: Community where independent founders build and grow profitable online businesses, sharing strategies and stories - a bootstrapper/indie alternative to venture-scale startups.
evidence_quote: Work Together to Build Profitable Online Businesses
notes: Founder and founding year pending verification (not on fetched page). Verified anchor (Ethan blueprint).

name: MicroConf
ethos: Community and conferences for non-venture-track, bootstrapped/self-funded startup founders building sustainable businesses outside the VC model.
evidence_quote: the world's most trusted community for non-venture track startup founders
notes: Founded 2011 (About page); co-founder Rob Walling. Verified anchor (Ethan blueprint).

name: Jugaad
ethos: Frugal, flexible, non-conventional innovation - improvised fixes and resourceful workarounds that solve problems with limited means.
examples: Frugal product design; repair; business and management innovation; life hacks
evidence_quote: a concept of non-conventional and frugal innovation on the Indian subcontinent. It also includes innovative fixes or simple workarounds
notes: Popularized in business via 'Jugaad Innovation' (Radjou et al., 2012). Verified anchor (Ethan blueprint).

name: Camels
ethos: Startups built for resilience and survival - balancing growth with cash flow and profitability from day one, able to endure harsh conditions, vs unicorns' growth-at-all-costs.
evidence_quote: Startups, It's Time to Think Like Camels - Not Unicorns
notes: Coined/popularized by Alex Lazarow (HBR 2020; book 'Out-Innovate', 2020). Quote shown is the verbatim article title; body-text quote pending a controlled fetch (HBR paywalled). Verified anchor (Ethan blueprint).

name: Seedstrapping
ethos: Raise a single seed round to launch, then grow to profitability on revenue while deliberately avoiding later rounds (Series A+) - a middle path between bootstrapping and multi-round VC.
evidence_quote: raising an initial Seed round to kickstart commercial operations and then focusing on revenue-driven growth, deliberately avoiding subsequent funding rounds like Series A
notes: Recent term (2024-2025 founder discourse); GoHub credits Henry Shi's analysis; Alex Lazarow: 'The Rise of Seed-Strapping Camels'. Verified anchor (Ethan blueprint).

name: Afrikabal
ethos: Pan-African 'continental holding company' that operates its companies under one balance sheet and one long horizon; holds for generations not quarters, explicitly not flipped for the next round.
examples: Rovify; Justly; AxiomWorld; Majira Marefu; OTJ Holdings
evidence_quote: We hold for generations, not quarters. Companies are operated to compound for fifty years - not flipped for the next round.
